title: Questions 149-150 refer to the following text-message chain.
passage_1:
Elodie Marchand (8:41 A.M.)
We need a live band for Saturday’s reception at Harefield Hall. The one we booked has withdrawn.

Dev Ramanathan (8:41 A.M.)
That is very short notice. Have you told the participants yet?

Elodie Marchand (8:42 A.M.)
Not yet. I wanted to find a replacement first.

Dev Ramanathan (8:43 A.M.)
Let’s give it until the end of the day. I will review my own contacts immediately.

Elodie Marchand (8:43 A.M.)
Understood. Same here.

Dev Ramanathan (8:44 A.M.)
We should really have a cancellation charge for performers who drop out at the last minute. It causes so much trouble.
